mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_job (checkpoint_date, corporate_number) SELECT DISTINCT checkpoint_date, corporate_number FROM company_entry WHERE checkpoint_date = #{transactionDate} ON CONFLICT (checkpoint_date, corporate_number) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE export_job SET status = 'processing', claimed_by = #{workerId}, claimed_at = now(), locked_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE (checkpoint_date, corporate_number) IN (SELECT checkpoint_date, corporate_number FROM export_job WHERE checkpoint_date = #{transactionDate} AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'processing' AND locked_until < now()) OR (status = 'failed' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}) ) ORDER BY corporate_number LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING corporate_number
